description: Reports the state of one conversion: "processing" while it runs, "error" with the reason when it failed (nothing charged), or "done" with a summary: file name, bank, account last digits, statement period, reconciliation outcome (balanced, unbalanced or unverifiable) and difference, transaction count, pages read and charged, number of accounts found, and up to five reconciliation notes. Transaction rows are not returned; use get_download_link for the file. Poll this after convert_statement every 10 seconds until the status is done or error.

conversion_id.description: The conversion id returned by convert_statement or list_conversions.

name: get_conversion

accounts.description: Number of accounts found in the file; more than 1 means `account` can be passed to get_download_link.

outcome.description: Reconciliation outcome: whether opening + credits − debits equals the closing balance.

title: Check a conversion
